hero.title:
ZEPPELIN
BEACH COMPLEX
hero.subtitle: Your base for chill — and the start of every adventure.

bar.heading: Chill at the highest level.
bar.description: Kick back with perfect cocktails, music, and a view of the sea. Great vibes, sunbeds, and shaded terraces waiting for you every day.
bar.sunbed_info: Info at the water sports desk

bar_page.description: Our beach bar serves handcrafted cocktails, refreshing drinks, and cold beer from morning till late. Enjoy the sea view from the terrace, find your spot at the bar, and let the music set the pace.

relax_page.description: Rent a sunbed and claim your corner of paradise. Shaded terraces and open sun spots available — settle in, order a drink from the bar, and let the day unfold.

action.heading: On water, in the air, on land.
action.note: Pay at the water sports info desk

wibit.description: An inflatable obstacle course on open water — test your balance, race your friends, and battle the obstacles. Open for all ages.
wibit.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

tramp.description: A water trampoline anchored just off the shore — jump high, flip, and land in the sea. Pure fun for all ages.
tramp.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

pedaline.description: Pedal boats for families and groups, stand-up paddleboards for those who like a challenge. Navigate the bay and enjoy the view.
pedaline.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

tube.description: High-speed rides on the sea — pick your tube, grab the handles, and get dragged across the waves at full throttle. Multiple configurations available.
tube.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

jetski.description: Rent a jet ski and tear across the Adriatic. Whether you want a guided safari or solo exploration, our jet skis are ready to go. No experience needed — our team will brief you before you head out.
jetski.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

scuba.description: Explore the underwater Adriatic with a certified instructor by your side. Perfect for first-timers and experienced divers alike — crystal clear water, rich marine life, and unforgettable visibility.
scuba.pay_note: Pay at the water sports desk

adventure.heading: Book your adventure.
adventure.subtitle: Unforgettable experiences — book online, depart from our beach.

fastfood_page.description: Burgers, sandwiches, and grilled favourites made fresh on-site. Quick service so you spend less time in line and more time on the beach.

gelato_page.description: Handcrafted gelato and smoothie bowls made with fresh ingredients. The perfect stop between dips in the sea.

careers.heading: Join the Zeppelin team.
careers.subtitle: Apply for the season and work on the most beautiful beach in Pula.
careers.position_select_heading: Which position are you applying for?

position_categories.label: Zeppelin Adventures
position_categories.notice: Buggy and Quad require a valid driving licence. Jetski requires a valid skipper licence.

careers.success_msg: Thank you! We'll be in touch soon.

location.heading: Find us.
location.directions: We're on Saccorgiana Beach in Pula. Follow signs for "Zeppelin Beach" from the city centre.

privacy.intro: This page explains how Zeppelin Beach Complex collects, uses, and protects your personal data.
privacy.who_body: Zeppelin Beach Complex operates on Saccorgiana Beach, Pula, Croatia. Contact: info@zeppelinbar.hr
privacy.data_body: We collect personal data only through the careers application form: full name, phone number, email address, and CV (PDF). No other personal data is collected through this website.
privacy.purpose_body: Application data is used solely to review job applications. It is not used for marketing, not shared with third parties, and not sold.
privacy.retention_body: CVs and application data are deleted at the end of the hiring season. If you would like your data removed sooner, contact us at info@zeppelinbar.hr.
privacy.analytics_body: This website uses Vercel Analytics, a cookieless analytics tool. It does not set cookies, does not collect personal identifiers, and does not perform cross-site tracking.
privacy.cookies_body: This website does not set personal cookies. We use browser localStorage only to remember your language preference and whether you have dismissed the cookie notice.
privacy.rights_body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data. To exercise any right, contact us at info@zeppelinbar.hr.

ui.cards_hint: Click on a card to learn more.
ui.cookie_notice: We use cookieless analytics to improve your experience. No personal data is stored or sold.
